response.rationale: Reach z-score of 2.719 (~2.7 baseline SDs) is well above flag threshold while CPM moved only mildly (z=0.578), a pattern consistent with a genuine demand-side surge — more volume at roughly stable prices — rather than a price/competition repricing or noise. The own-action confound flag is false and OSA is flat (z=0.0), so the harness's prior bid/budget move is an unlikely explanation. Worth reacting to.
